title: Complexities of Weak Proximal Oracle Methods for Composite Convex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.24423v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider a standard convex composite optimization problem with either smooth or nonsmooth objective function, and under quadratic growth. In recent years, several works gave algorithms based on a \textit{weak proximal oracle} (WPO) that essentially match in oracle complexities proximal (sub)gradient methods relying on exact prox operations. Importantly, such WPOs, which relax the strong optimality condition of the standard prox operator, may admit much more efficient implementation in terms of runtime when optimal solutions have some sparse structure. A question remained if such WPO-based methods can be accelerated (in the sense of Nesterov's accelerated gradient). In this work we provide a negative answer by establishing lower bounds against both deterministic and randomized methods. translated_title: 复合凸优化中弱近端Oracle方法的复杂度
translated_abstract: 我们研究一个标准的复合凸优化问题，其目标函数可以是光滑或非光滑的，并在二次增长条件下进行考虑。近年来，一些工作提出了基于“弱近端Oracle”（WPO）的算法，其在Oracle复杂度上基本匹配依赖精确近端操作的近端（次）梯度方法。重要的是，这类WPO放宽了标准近端算子的强最优性条件，当最优解具有某种稀疏结构时，在运行时间上可能允许更加高效的实现。一个悬而未决的问题是：这类基于WPO的方法能否被加速（在Nesterov加速梯度的意义上）。在本工作中，我们通过建立针对确定性方法和随机化方法的下界，给出了否定的答案。因此，尽管WPO可以大幅降低单次Oracle调用的成本，但这伴随着Oracle复杂度上的固有损失。
tldr: 该论文通过建立确定性和随机方法的下界，证明了弱近端Oracle方法无法实现Nesterov意义上的加速，表明WPO虽能大幅降低单次调用的计算成本，但必然带来Oracle复杂度上的固有损失。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes lower bounds for both deterministic and randomized methods, proving that weak proximal oracle (WPO) methods cannot be accelerated in the sense of Nesterov, thereby showing that while WPOs substantially reduce per-call costs, they inherently suffer a loss in oracle complexity.
